items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: It couldn't have been somebody like Shelley LaMelle or...

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah, sure. Who would they be selling? Oh, Pop Celestan played up there. Mm-hmm. Rene played there. Mm-hmm. And, uh, Sidney Dezby played there. Oh, they had bands up there. Mm-hmm.
I'm trying to think of that trumpet player who was a class, right? It couldn't have been somebody like Shelley LaMelle or...
